headline: Frontline Flux Intensifies Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the map still shows a largely static front, but the tempo of ownership changes has risen in the same half‑dozen theatres and spread to two new pressure points. Weathered Expanse remains the hottest sector with 62 ownership flips in the past day, colonial losses climbing to 8,528 and Warden losses to 14,186 while fresh enlistments reach 447. Fishermans Row follows with 36 flips, colonial dead up 394 and Warden dead 546, enlistments 221. Callahans Passage holds at 30 flips but casualties surge — colonial +10,002, Warden +13,424 — and enlistments climb to 908. Stlican Shelf records 32 flips, colonial +2,224, Warden +2,616, enlistments 263. Mooring County steadies at 14 flips, colonial +6,113, Warden +7,167, enlistments 711. Stema Landing adds nine flips with modest losses (21 colonial, 12 Warden) and 58 enlistments. Previously quiet Linn Mercy remains at three flips, while Palantine Berm and Nevish Line have each logged their first significant activity this cycle — Palantine Berm 10 flips, 597 colonial and 656 Warden casualties, 188 enlistments; Nevish Line 10 flips, 4,896 colonial and 4,209 Warden casualties, 515 enlistments. All other regions report no ownership changes.
